We have all kinds of illnesses constantly circulating around the world with the way we travel it can happen so fast.

nodes.text:
Most medical facilities aren't even masking to prevent COVID, flu of any sort or any other illnesses.
Totally not optimistic about how things are going to play out. 
Our govs/public health/HCWs need to get it together & act like we are living in a pandemic BECAUSE WE ARE.
